# An excerpt of the board trace of gl_test case 122 (uniidxi) through the
# NanoPC-T6's own Mesa, for the frame builder's uniform-block proof
# (src/mali/frame_ubo_tests.rs): the command-stream words of the draw, the
# raw memory of the buffer that holds the draw's descriptors (resource
# tables, the UBO Buffer descriptor, the uniform block, the FAU;
# 7ffffffcf000) and of the buffer that holds the shader program descriptors
# (7fffffffd000).
#
# Board: NanoPC-T6 (RK3588, Mali-G610, GPU_ID 0xa8670005), Armbian,
# Linux 6.18.55-current-rockchip64, panthor, Mesa 25.0.7-2+deb13u1 (an
# OpenGL ES 3.1 context). The program, 0dce654a8:tools/mali/board-ref/
# 2026-10-20-mesa-refs/cases.c in its `uniidxi` mode (case 122's body:
# `vec4 fcols[4]` = (0,0,0,1), (1,0,0,1), (0.2,0.4,0.6,1), (0,1,0,1), `int
# fidx` = 2, a 1x1 opaque black texture), by the steps of
# tools/mali/mesa-board-ref.sh (PAN_MESA_DEBUG=linear,nocrc,dump,trace,sync):
# 0dce654a8:tools/mali/board-ref/2026-10-20-mesa-refs/mesa/mesa-uniidxi.pandecode.
#
# What the excerpt pins (docs/notes/mali-uniform-index.md section 6): the
# fragment resource table's entry 0 is a UBO table of one Buffer (Size
# 0x20), the Buffer's Size is 36, the exact packed bytes of the block (the
# four mediump vec4 elements as fp16 pairs at bytes 0-31, fidx at byte 32),
# the block's bytes at 7ffffffcf2a0, and the fragment FAU at 7ffffffcf2d0:
# fidx (2) and a pad word.
#
# Cut with: tools/mali/board_dump_cut.py <dump> uniidxi 7ffffffcf000 7fffffffd000
